ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Finisher Legacy uses the camera so you can take photos of your medal, your races or your profile when you choose to.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Finisher Legacy uses your photos so you can choose images and videos of your races: your medal photo, your moments, your memories and your profile picture. Only what you choose is uploaded.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Finisher Legacy uses your location only when you start it: to measure the distance of your outdoor workout and, if you turn on live tracking, so the people you share it with can follow your progress.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow “Always” so your workout or live tracking keeps measuring even if you lock your phone. It is only used while they are active and you can stop them whenever you want.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Allow “Always” so your workout or live tracking keeps measuring even if you lock your phone. It is only used while they are active.
ios.NFCReaderUsageDescription: Finisher Legacy uses NFC only when you ask for it, to activate, read or verify your Finisher Legacy Tag when you hold it near your phone.
